pictures.scene: Karl Friedrich Schinkel, Medieval City with Cathedral — the great Gothic church standing up over the town on its height with two tiered towers and an open stone spire and a rose window set in the front, a white banner flying from a mast beside it, a rainbow going right over the whole building out of a dark storm sky, and far below among the trees a long procession in red and gold winding up the hillside with its banners up, to the angel of the church in Sardis write, these are the words of the One who holds
pictures.name: pd_schinkel_medieval_city_with_cathedral

pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, The Starry Night — the night sky rolling over in great blue and white coils with the stars burning out of it in rings of yellow light and the moon blazing low at one side, the black cypress going up the near edge of the picture like a flame, the hills lying dark along the bottom and the little town asleep under them with its thin church spire and one or two windows still lit, the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars, I know your deeds you have a reputation for being alive
pictures.name: pd_van_gogh_the_starry_night

pictures.scene: Arnold Bocklin, The Isle of the Dead — the black wall of cypresses standing straight up out of the island in the middle of still dark water, the bare rock cliffs on either side of them cut with square burial chambers, a little rowing boat come in close with the oarsman bent over his oars and a white coffin laid across the thwarts, and one figure standing upright in the bow wrapped head to foot in white, yet you are dead, wake up and strengthen what remains
pictures.name: pd_bocklin_the_isle_of_the_dead

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, The Demolition of Saint-Jean — the church being pulled down in broad daylight, the nave opened to the sky with its vaults broken through and the ribs left standing bare, white dust and smoke boiling up out of the gutted inside with a red glow at the foot of it, the two towers still up over the wreck with their windows empty, the ground in front heaped with cut stone and timber, and a few small figures at the corner watching it come apart, which is about to die, for I have found your deeds incomplete
pictures.name: pd_robert_demolition_saint_jean

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, An Elderly Man in Prayer — the old man close up out of a brown dark in a plain fawn robe, grey hair swept back off his forehead and a long grey beard down over his chest, his eyes shut and his head bent a little, both worn hands pressed flat together in front of him with the light catching every knuckle, and the open book lying out below on the table with its ruled page turned up to him, in the sight of My God, remember then what you have received and heard
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_elderly_man_in_prayer

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, The Night Watch — the militia company turning out of a brown dark gateway at the word of command, the captain in black with a broad white lace collar and a red sash across him putting his hand out to give the order, the lieutenant beside him in pale yellow with a white silk sash and a gilt gorget at his throat, a musketeer behind them with his piece up at his shoulder, and the rest of the company crowding in under their feathered hats with the long pikes and a lance crossing the air over their heads, keep it and repent, if you do not wake up I will come like a thief
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_the_night_watch

pictures.scene: Aert van der Neer, River View by Moonlight — the full moon hung small and pale high in a grey clouded sky and laying one long broken track down the still river, the flat far bank running away with a windmill and a church tower and the roofs of a village on it and the sails of the fishing boats standing up black against the last light, a man in a punt by the near reeds working at his rope beside a barrel, and on the dark track in front a carter with his horses and his dog going by in the half light, and you will not know the hour, when I will come upon you
pictures.name: pd_van_der_neer_river_view_by_moonlight

pictures.scene: Pieter de Hooch, The Courtyard of a House in Delft — the little brick yard swept clean to the last paving stone, the housewife in a white cap and a white kerchief and a blue skirt under a dark apron coming down the step with a dish in one hand and the small girl in yellow holding on to the other and looking up at her, the red and white brick arch beside them with its carved stone tablet set over the passage and another woman standing away through it in the light, and the wooden pail and the long broom left out on the bricks in front, but you do have a few people in Sardis, who have not soiled their garments
pictures.name: pd_de_hooch_courtyard_of_a_house_in_delft

pictures.scene: Hans Memling, Singing Angels — Christ seated at one side of the gold ground in a tall jewelled crown and a deep blue robe with a jewelled band across His breast and a stiff gold orphrey falling down it, the fine gold rays going out all round His head, two fingers lifted over the great jewelled clasp and the crystal orb standing at His knee, and the crowned angels gathered close beside Him on the cloud in green and gold copes with their red and blue wings up behind them, all singing out of one big open book held between their hands, and because they are worthy, they will walk with Me in white
pictures.name: pd_memling_singing_angels

pictures.scene: Matthias Grunewald, The Concert of Angels — the great carved and gilded canopy of leaves and twisted columns filling the picture, and under it the angels playing, the nearest one kneeling right in front in a plain white robe with pale wings and fair hair, his head tipped back as he draws the bow across a big white viol, another behind him leaning in to a second viol in a rose coloured mantle, more faces and haloes crowding the dark behind them, and off at the side a crowned figure standing in a blaze of golden light, like them he who overcomes, will be dressed in white
pictures.name: pd_grunewald_the_concert_of_angels

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Anna Reading — the old woman sitting alone out of a brown dark in a heavy red fur-lined gown with a gold embroidered cloth wound over her head and hanging down at her shoulder, bent right over the huge book propped open on the stand in front of her, her one lit hand laid flat on the page to hold her place, and all the light in the picture coming up off the written leaves into her face, and I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life, but I will confess his name
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_anna_reading

pictures.scene: Andrey Mironov, Guardian Angel — the one great white wing coming down across the whole picture in long feathers of cream and grey and blue, the deep blue of the sky showing through behind it, and tucked in close under the wing and the angel's arm a small dark haired child in a pale robe with a white collar, held in against him and looking quietly out of the picture at us, before My Father and His angels, he who has an ear let him hear
pictures.name: pd_mironov_guardian_angel

pictures.scene: Gentile Bellini, Procession in Piazza San Marco — the whole front of the great church standing across the top of the picture with its grey domes and its gold mosaics and the four bronze horses over the middle arch, and the brotherhood walking in procession over the brick square below in long pale habits, two by two with their staves and their candles, the gilt reliquary carried up on its poles in the middle of them and the red and gold canopy going ahead, and the citizens of the city standing about in red and black watching them pass, what the Spirit says to the churches, to the angel of the church in Philadelphia write
pictures.name: pd_bellini_procession_piazza_san_marco

pictures.scene: Guercino, King David — the king sitting back in his chair in a rose coloured robe with a gold mantle thrown across him and an ermine lining showing at the shoulder, a small jewelled crown set over his white turban, his beard down on his breast and his head turned down and aside in thought, the long slender sceptre held loosely in one hand, and his other hand laid out on a great stone tablet lettered in Latin standing up beside him, these are the words of the One who is holy and true, who holds the key of David
pictures.name: pd_guercino_king_david

pictures.scene: Gustav Bauernfeind, The Gate of Jerusalem — the narrow old street running under a great pointed stone arch thrown clean across it, the yellow limestone walls above hung with latticed windows and jutting shutters and a lamp swinging in the opening, the light falling in a broad patch on the worn paving, an old man in a white head cloth coming through on his staff, a boy in a red coat with his dog behind him, the sellers at their trays along the wall and the street going on far through the arch into the bright city beyond, what He opens no one can shut, and what He shuts no one can open
pictures.name: pd_bauernfeind_jerusalem_gate

pictures.scene: Nikolay Bogdanov-Belsky, At the School Door — the plank door of the village schoolroom standing wide open, and a ragged barefoot boy halted in the opening with his stick in his hand and a cloth bundle slung at his shoulder, his coat out at the elbows and his legs wrapped in rags and bast shoes, leaning against the door post and looking in at the lit room where the other children sit close together at their benches under the blackboard and the map, I know your deeds, see I have placed before you an open door
pictures.name: pd_bogdanov_schooldeur

pictures.scene: Charles Emile Jacque, Shepherdess and Flock — the green clearing under the heavy dark trees with the ewe standing out in the light grazing the grass, and the small white lamb pressed in close against her side with its head turned up, and away under the trunks at the edge of the wood the shepherdess in a white cap leaning both hands on her tall staff and watching them, which no one can shut, for you have only a little strength
pictures.name: pd_jacque_shepherdess_flock

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, An Old Woman Praying — the old woman alone against a plain dark wall in a black hood and a fur trimmed gown with a worked band across her forehead, her lined face turned down and her eyes nearly shut, both hands lifted and laid together in front of her, and the heavy clasped book set out on the table in the shadow under her hands, yet you have kept My word, and have not denied My name
pictures.name: pd_dou_praying_old_woman

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Judas Returning the Thirty Pieces of Silver — the dim hall of the temple with a great gold lamp hanging down one side of it, the man in the striped turban and the red and gold mantle turning away with his hand thrown out to refuse what is offered, the tall priest in the dark cap behind him staring out with his mouth open and two more crowding in at the back, the betrayer down on both knees on the floor in a torn brown coat with his hair half torn out and his hands wrung together, and the small coins lying scattered over the boards where he threw them, look at those who belong to the synagogue of Satan, who claim to be Jews but are liars instead
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_judas_returning_the_thirty_pieces_of_silver

pictures.scene: King David Kneeling before an Altar — the king down on one knee on the step in plain steel armour under a heavy gold cope worked all over with little pictures in its borders, a jewelled crown on his red hair and one hand laid flat on his breast as he turns his face up, his harp standing against him with his other hand across the strings, an attendant beside him holding open a book lettered in Latin, and an angel in white coming down out of the cloud above with the banner streaming behind, I will make them come and bow down at your feet, and they will know that I love you
pictures.name: pd_king_david_kneeling_before_an_altar

pictures.scene: Ludolf Bakhuizen, Christ in the Storm on the Sea of Galilee — the little open boat flung up on the white of a breaking sea under a sky gone black from edge to edge with the rain coming down in long streaks across it, the sail torn loose and bellying out with all its ropes flying, one man forward hauling himself up the stay with his whole weight and another holding the tiller aft, and the rest crowded down together in the bottom of the boat, the white-bearded one with his arm thrown out and a man in a red robe sitting quiet in the middle of them while the spray goes over the bow, because you have kept My command to endure, I will also keep you from the hour of testing
pictures.name: pd_bakhuizen_christ_in_the_storm_on_the_sea_of_galilee

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Twilight in the Wilderness — the whole sky burning red over an empty country at the end of the day, long bars of torn cloud lit up along their under edges and running away to a band of clear yellow light low on the horizon, the dark ridges of hills standing one behind another in blue and brown without a house or a road anywhere on them, the still water lying below holding the red of the sky in it with one small island of firs out in the middle, and the rocks and the fir branches dark in the near corners,that is about to come upon the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth
pictures.name: pd_church_twilight_in_the_wilderness

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Woman before the Rising Sun — the woman standing alone on the stony path in a long dark dress, seen from behind with her hair pinned up, both arms opened out from her sides and her hands turned up, facing the gold light coming over the low hills in front of her, the bare brown moor with its tufts of grass running away on either side of her and nothing else in the picture at all,I am coming soon, hold fast to what you have
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_woman_rising_sun

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, The Coronation of the Virgin — Christ sitting high up on the gold throne in a rose robe and a great blue mantle with a crown on His head, holding a second gold crown out in both hands and setting it down on the bowed head of the woman kneeling before Him with her hands joined, the throne standing between two carved white twisted columns with ranks of haloed angels in pink crowding in at both sides blowing trumpets and playing lutes, and below on the chequered floor the saints kneeling up the steps, a bishop in a mitre and a green cope figured with little scenes, one in pink holding out a gold vessel, and two more in red and blue with their hands pressed together,so that no one will take your crown, the one who overcomes I will make a pillar
pictures.name: pd_angelico_coronation

pictures.scene: David Roberts, The Portico of the Temple of Edfu — the great stone front of the temple standing up out of the drifted sand with the winged sun disk carved right across the top of it, the wall below cut all over with rows of seated gods and hieroglyphs, the thick columns of the portico running away into shadow on either side of the dark doorway, the sand lying smooth and pale in a long slope over the buried court with cart tracks drawn across it, and two or three small figures in cloaks out on the rock at the near edge looking up at it,in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it
pictures.name: pd_roberts_portico_edfu

pictures.scene: Philippe de Champaigne, Moses Presenting the Tablets of the Law — the old man close up out of a black ground with two short horns of light standing out of his white hair, his long grey and gold beard falling over a blue mantle and a gold embroidered robe, looking straight out at us with his lips parted, holding the two tall grey stone tablets upright against himself with one hand at the top and the other spread at the bottom, every commandment on them written out in plain lettering and numbered down the stone, and his gold staff laid across the whole picture from his shoulder to the ledge in front,upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God
pictures.name: pd_de_champaigne_moses_presenting_the_tablets_of_the_law

pictures.scene: Frederic Edwin Church, Jerusalem from the Mount of Olives — the whole city laid out along the top of the far ridge in the hazy gold light, the long battlemented wall running right across the picture with a sealed gate in it, the round dome standing up over its wide platform with minarets and packed white roofs crowded away behind, a huge pile of cloud climbing over it into the pale sky, the bare valley with its scattered olive trees falling away below, and on the stony path at the bottom a man on a camel with two others walking beside him, their long shadows thrown out over the rock,the new Jerusalem that comes down, out of heaven from My God
pictures.name: pd_church_jerusalem_from_the_mount_of_olives

pictures.scene: Frans Hals, The Singing Boy with a Flute — the boy close up against a plain warm wall in a black cap with a great white plume curling off it, his brown hair pushed out under the brim, his head tipped down and his mouth open in the middle of a note, a white collar showing at the neck of his soft grey coat, one hand holding the little wooden flute across the table in front of him and the other lifted open beside him beating the time, and the open book of music lying under his elbow at the bottom of the picture,and My new name, he who has an ear let him hear
pictures.name: pd_hals_singing_boy_with_flute

pictures.scene: Gerrit Berckheyde, The Grote Kerk in Haarlem — the whitewashed aisle of the great church going away from us under its pointed vaults, a brass chandelier hanging on a long chain down the middle of it and the carved wooden pulpit standing out high on the right, plain piers and hatchments and memorial boards along the walls, a tall man in a black hat and cloak and another in a wide plumed hat standing talking in the near corner, and out on the stone floor beyond them a woman in a gold skirt and two men bending right down over an opened grave slab with their tools and the earth beside it,what the Spirit says to the churches, to the angel of the church in Laodicea write
pictures.name: pd_berckheyde_bavokerk

pictures.scene: Giovanni Bellini, Christ Blessing — Christ standing close up against an evening sky in a plain white robe banded with worked gold at the neck and the sleeves, the crown of thorns still pressed down on His dark hair with a small gold burst of rays behind it, His face turned a little aside and His lips parted, one hand raised at the edge of the picture and the other laid across a heavy clasped black book held against Him, the nail wound showing through the back of that hand and a small opening cut in the robe over the wound in His side,these are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true Witness
pictures.name: pd_bellini_blessing_christ

pictures.scene: Ivan Aivazovsky, Chaos, the Creation of the World — a white burst of light high up in the middle of a gold sky with a dim figure standing in it with arms spread, the great dark masses of cloud rolled and torn open all round the light and the gold breaking through between them, and far below the first sea running in long white-crested waves out of the dark with the light laid down over the water in a broad track, no land and nothing living anywhere in it,the Originator of God's creation, I know your deeds
pictures.name: pd_aivazovsky_chaos_the_creation_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, Hunters in the Snow — the hunters trudging home down the snow slope with their backs to us, one in a dark hat with a spear over his shoulder and another bent under his load, a third coming up behind with his pike held low, the lean dogs strung out around their feet with their heads down and their tails hanging, the bare black trunks of the trees standing up one after another across the whole picture with a crow sitting in the branches, the inn with its people and a little fire at the left, and the snowed-in village and the frozen ponds and the white hills lying away below under a cold green sky,you are neither cold nor hot, how I wish you were one or the other
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_hunters_in_the_snow

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, The Sea of Ice — the frozen sea broken up into great slabs and thrown one over another, a pile of pale green plates driven up into a jagged peak in the middle of the picture with the snow lying along their edges, the flat brown and grey floes stacked across the whole foreground, the stern and the broken spars of a crushed ship showing out of the heap on the right, and nothing beyond but white haze and a cold blue sky,so because you are lukewarm, neither hot nor cold
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_sea_of_ice

pictures.scene: Quentin Metsys, The Moneylender and His Wife — the man in a black fur cap and a brown gown sitting at the counting table with his eyes down, holding up the little gold balance in his fingers to weigh the coins, the heaps of money and the rings and the pearls spread out on the cloth in front of him, his wife beside him in a red dress and a white head cloth with her hand on the leaf of an illuminated prayer book, turning away from the page to watch the scales, a round convex mirror lying on the table at the front reflecting a window and a man, and the shelf behind them with a jar and books and a snuffed-out candle,I am about to vomit you out of My mouth, you say I am rich I have grown wealthy
pictures.name: pd_metsys_the_moneylender_and_his_wife

pictures.scene: Hieronymus Bosch, Death and the Miser — the old man in a long green gown and a green cap bending over his open strongbox with a rosary and a bunch of keys hanging at his belt and a stick under his hand, dropping a coin down into the purse that a little grey demon holds up to him out of the chest, more demons crawling under the box and pushing papers at him, a dark winged thing with a white face looking over the parapet below, and the cast-off robes and the helmet and the lance of his old life lying abandoned on the floor in front,and need nothing, but you do not realize that you are wretched
pictures.name: pd_bosch_death_and_the_miser

pictures.scene: John Everett Millais, The Blind Girl — the beggar girl sitting out on the grass at the edge of the meadow in a worn gold skirt with a brown shawl over her red hair, her eyes shut and her face lifted into the sun, a little placard at her neck and the concertina resting on her lap under her hand, the younger child curled in against her shoulder in a blue dress with her hair falling loose, holding the shawl up and looking back at the two rainbows standing over the wet fields, the cattle and the sheep and the rooks out on the grass behind them and the village and its church along the far ridge,pitiful poor blind and naked, I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire
pictures.name: pd_millais_the_blind_girl

pictures.scene: Circle of Rembrandt, The Man with the Golden Helmet — the old soldier standing out of a black ground with the one lit thing in the picture a beaten gold helmet on his head, its brim and crest worked all over in heavy raised scrollwork and catching the light along every edge, a dark plume of feathers broken out of the top of it, his face left in shadow under the brim with his eyes down and his white moustache and stubble just showing, and the dull steel of his gorget and shoulder plates sinking away into the dark below,so that you may become rich, white garments so that you may be clothed
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_circle_the_man_with_the_golden_helmet

pictures.scene: El Greco, Christ Healing the Blind — the knot of onlookers crowded together on the pale stone steps, the bald old man in a blue mantle at the front with his white beard and his arm stretched right out and his hand open, another man in green reaching past him, a grey-bearded one and a smooth-faced youth looking over their shoulders, a figure in a rose sleeve and a gold skirt turned away from us at the near edge, and behind them the open square with its arcaded white building and a wagon and horses going by small in the distance under a blue sky full of broken cloud,and your shameful nakedness not exposed, and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see
pictures.name: pd_el_greco_christ_healing_the_blind

pictures.scene: El Greco, Saint Peter in Tears — the old fisherman standing in the dark under a rock with the ivy hanging down over it, wrapped in a heavy yellow mantle over a blue-green robe, his grey hair and his white beard pushed about, his face turned up and his wet eyes lifted with the tears standing in them, his two weathered hands gripped hard together in front of his breast, and the two iron keys hanging on a cord from his wrist down the front of the yellow cloak,those I love I rebuke and discipline, therefore be earnest and repent
pictures.name: pd_elgreco_peter_in_tears

pictures.scene: William Holman Hunt, The Light of the World — Christ standing at night in the overgrown orchard in a long white robe with a jewelled clasp and a dark embroidered cloak over His shoulders, a gold crown of thorns on His head and a faint ring of light behind it, His bare feet in the wet grass among the fallen apples, one hand raised to knock at the shut plank door at the left that is grown over with ivy and weeds and has no handle on His side, and the other holding up a pierced lantern whose candlelight falls out over His robe and the brambles,behold I stand at the door and knock, if anyone hears My voice and opens the door
pictures.name: pd_hunt_the_light_of_the_world

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Supper at Emmaus — Christ sitting at the inn table in a red tunic with a white mantle over His shoulder, His dark hair loose and His eyes cast down, one hand raised out over the table in blessing and the other resting by the bread, the white cloth spread in front of Him with a roast bird on a dish, a loaf, a glass of wine and a basket of grapes and pomegranates and apples pushed out to the very edge, the innkeeper standing over Him in the dark, and the old bald disciple at the right thrown back with both hands opened wide as he recognizes Him,I will come in and dine with him, and he with Me
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_supper_at_emmaus

pictures.scene: Jan van Eyck, God Enthroned — the enthroned figure close up and straight on, a tall triple tiara of pearls and blue and red stones set on His head and His dark hair falling long on both shoulders over a deep red mantle, the jewelled orphrey bands sewn with little crosses hanging down either side of His breast and a great round clasp of pearls and sapphires holding the mantle together, gold rays going out all round His head into a gold arch lettered in Latin behind Him, and the worked gold of the throne back showing past His shoulders,to the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne
pictures.name: pd_van_eyck_god_enthroned

pictures.scene: Fra Angelico, Christ in Glory — Christ sitting in the middle of a deep blue oval ring set all round with little winged heads, in a pale blue robe with a gold halo crossed in red behind Him, one hand lifted and the other laid open on His knee, the gold rays of the sunburst going out behind Him and over the whole ground, a winged angel standing below the ring holding the tall cross upright, and the saints and the crowned ranks of heaven standing close on both sides on their little clouds with their hands pressed together,just as I overcame and sat down, with My Father on His throne
pictures.name: pd_fra_angelico_christ_in_glory

pictures.scene: Galla Placidia Mausoleum, The Good Shepherd — the young shepherd set in gold and coloured stone in the lunette, sitting out on the rock in a gold tunic with a blue mantle over His knee and a great gold halo behind His head, holding a tall gold cross upright like a staff in one hand and putting the other out to stroke the chin of the sheep that has come up to Him, the rest of the little white flock standing about Him among the rocks and the bushes, and over the whole thing the deep blue vault of the roof worked with gold stars and rosettes,he who has an ear let him hear, what the Spirit says to the churches
pictures.name: pd_galla_placidia_the_good_shepherd_mosaic

lines.text: To the angel of the church in Sardis write:
These are the words of the One who holds
the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars:
I know your deeds; you have a reputation for being alive,
yet you are dead.
Wake up and strengthen what remains,
which is about to die;
for I have found your deeds incomplete
in the sight of My God.
Remember, then, what you have received and heard.
Keep it and repent.
If you do not wake up, I will come like a thief,
and you will not know the hour
when I will come upon you.
But you do have a few people in Sardis
who have not soiled their garments,
and because they are worthy,
they will walk with Me in white.
Like them, he who overcomes
will be dressed in white.
And I will never blot out his name from the Book of Life,
but I will confess his name
before My Father and His angels.
He who has an ear, let him hear
what the Spirit says to the churches.
To the angel of the church in Philadelphia write:
These are the words of the One who is holy and true,
who holds the key of David.
What He opens, no one can shut;
and what He shuts, no one can open.
I know your deeds.
See, I have placed before you an open door,
which no one can shut.
For you have only a little strength,
yet you have kept My word
and have not denied My name.
Look at those who belong to the synagogue of Satan,
who claim to be Jews but are liars instead.
I will make them come and bow down at your feet,
and they will know that I love you.
Because you have kept My command to endure,
I will also keep you from the hour of testing
that is about to come upon the whole world,
to test those who dwell on the earth.
I am coming soon.
Hold fast to what you have,
so that no one will take your crown.
The one who overcomes I will make a pillar
in the temple of My God,
and he will never again leave it.
Upon him I will write the name of My God,
and the name of the city of My God,
the new Jerusalem that comes down
out of heaven from My God,
and My new name.
He who has an ear, let him hear
what the Spirit says to the churches.
To the angel of the church in Laodicea write:
These are the words of the Amen,
the faithful and true Witness,
the Originator of God's creation.
I know your deeds;
you are neither cold nor hot.
How I wish you were one or the other!
So because you are lukewarm,
neither hot nor cold,
I am about to vomit you out of My mouth!
You say, I am rich; I have grown wealthy
and need nothing.
But you do not realize that you are wretched,
pitiful, poor, blind, and naked.
I counsel you to buy from Me gold refined by fire,
so that you may become rich;
white garments so that you may be clothed
and your shameful nakedness not exposed;
and salve to anoint your eyes so that you may see.
Those I love, I rebuke and discipline.
Therefore be earnest and repent.
Behold, I stand at the door and knock.
If anyone hears My voice and opens the door,
I will come in and dine with him,
and he with Me.
To the one who overcomes,
I will grant the right to sit with Me on My throne,
just as I overcame and sat down
with My Father on His throne.
He who has an ear, let him hear
what the Spirit says to the churches.
